subject: Case study visibility tradeoff — request for credit in Q3 renewal
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Case study visibility tradeoff — customer asking for credit in renewal

Team —

Quick summary: Aperture Labs (renewal Q3, ARR ~$420k) is asking for a one-time 30% credit on the upcoming renewal in exchange for a marketing bundle: a written case study (approx 2 pages), customer quote, and logo usage on our site + a short (30s) product highlight clip. They want marketing-ready assets by Oct 1 so they can align with their product launch.

Why this matters: the opportunity is material to our Q3 numbers and the customer has strong brand recognition in our target vertical. They’ve only asked for the credit as part of the publicity package — legal flagged this as a non-standard publicity-for-credit tradeoff and asked we get exec signoff. Deal desk asked me to escalate since this impacts concession approval thresholds.

What I’m requesting from you:
- Rishi: do you approve a publicity-linked concession up to 30%? If not, what maximum discount can you accept without revenue committee signoff?
- Markus: please confirm legal constraints — length of logo usage, exclusivity concerns, and required indemnities.
- Evelyn: marketing please confirm if the assets described satisfy our case study standards and whether we can meet Oct 1.

Attachments: draft case study from customer (Aperture_case_draft.docx), their logo package (Aperture_logo.zip), and a proposed mutual action plan (mutual_action_plan.xlsx).

I recommend: approve conditionally (if legal ok) and tie to a 12-month visibility window and standard brand guidelines. If Rishi wants a deeper concession (>25%) this should go to Vivek for final signoff.

Thanks —
Camila
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Case study visibility tradeoff — customer asking for credit in renewal

Camila —

Thanks for the summary and attachments. High level from me: we generally avoid tying material discounts directly to publicity commitments because it creates sticky compliance and measurement problems. That said, Aperture is strategic for us in fintech, and the ARR in question plus the marketing lift could justify a concession.

Two immediate asks before I can approve anything close to 30%:
1) Confirm commitment length (12 vs 24 months). Prefer 12 months.
2) Confirm there is no exclusivity clause and that we retain rights to reuse the accepted quote in future collateral without an ongoing fee.

If both are satisfied, I can approve up to 25% credit. Anything above 25% needs Vivek signoff. Markus — can you flag legal risks (esp. right of publicity clauses or required indemnities)? Evelyn — can marketing produce a go/no-go on Oct 1 turnaround?

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Apps <jordan@appsinc.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Elena Morozova <elena@aperture.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Case study materials and timeline

Hi Camila —

Attaching the draft case study and logo package as requested (Aperture_case_draft.docx, Aperture_logo.zip). We’ve also filled out the mutual action plan. A couple clarifications:
- We cannot commit to 24 months of exclusivity — not part of the ask. 12 months is fine.
- We’d like Redwood to feature the logo and quote on the homepage for two weeks as part of our co-launch push; after that, standard logo placement on customer page is fine.
- For the discount, Aperture prefers a flat 30% credit applied at renewal. If that’s not possible, they can consider a two-year commit at 25%.

Happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Jordan Apps
Customer Success Manager | AppsInc (partnering with Aperture Labs)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Case study materials and timeline — request for Vivek signoff if >25%

Vivek —

Forwarding the thread. Customer asking for 30% credit tied to a case study + homepage visibility for two weeks. Camila has the attachments.

My recommendation: allow up to 25% credit with the following conditions: 12-month publicity window, standard brand usage terms, and a short co-marketing schedule that marketing approves. For 30% we’d need you to sign off because it materially impacts our renewal economics.

Markus — please call out any legal red flags (I’m particularly worried about rights to re-use the quote and any implied endorsements).

Thanks —
Rishi
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Case study materials and timeline — request for Vivek signoff if >25%

Thanks for the thread and clear recommendation. I approve the concession with conditions as follows:

1) Final approved credit: 30% one-time credit at renewal, conditional on the customer signing the mutual publicity addendum (no exclusivity, 12-month visibility window).
2) Marketing deliverables: customer to provide final assets by Oct 1 and Redwood marketing to have one week to review and request edits. Redwood gets perpetual rights to use the quote and case study across marketing channels with attribution; logo usage limited to brand guidelines and image assets provided.
3) Legal: Markus to add standard indemnity clause and a short publicity addendum; marketing must sign off on final creative.
4) Revenue guardrails: credit to be booked as a one-time contra-revenue line item and not to be used as baseline for future discounting. Finance to be notified (I'll loop them after this).

Camila — proceed to get the publicity addendum signed (DocuSign link attached) and confirm final assets by Oct 1. Please document the concession in the HubSpot deal record (DEAL-4897).

Vivek Kulkarni
Chief Revenue Officer | Redwood Inference
